notes: Each crop normalized separately to preserve proportions and avoid cross-shape stroke dilation. Auto stroke is a silhouette metric, not the gold hairline width; border-image controls displayed hairlines. Alpha preserved. Divider uses a 90px tall crop because the normalizer rejects cells shorter than 25px.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One production UI asset atlas, transparent 1536x1024 canvas, strict 3 columns x 2 rows grid. Row 1: square ink panel nine-slice frame; wide short panel header; wide short city nameplate band. Row 2: very thin horizontal row divider; small square seal backing; empty last cell. No text, letters, symbols, labels or watermark. Original restrained ink-and-paper strategy UI. References: ink-panel.webp rough ink edges, fibrous paper.webp, rubbed seal-bar.webp, muted ochre map. Palette #16120e, #221c16, #b9a46e. Matte ink wash, angular gold corner brackets in 64px corners, fine gold lines, 4px dry-brush bleed. Plain dark center, no pattern. Header and city band: painted ends, straight gold top/bottom lines, repeatable undecorated center. Divider: rubbed gold. Seal: dark crimson inset in ink. No bevel, shine, dragons, stone, perspective, shadows or excessive decoration.
